answer_1.quote: We introduce ELABORATION, a novel benchmark for Human-LLM competitive programming, which features a comprehensive evaluation protocol to facilitate a thorough assessment.
answer_1.outputs: code solutions for competitive programming problems

answer_2.quote: Following established practice ... we utilize the Pass@k (k=1,3,5) metric (Chen et al., 2021) to evaluate overall performance

answer_3.quote: In the comprehension stage, after the LLM has developed an understanding of the problem statement, O1-Mini is used for automatic fact-checking against the annotations of the clarifications and requirements specified in the dataset

answer_4.quote: We involve five computer science graduate students collaboratively solving competitive programming problems with LLMs. Each human participant receives detailed instructions ... and is permitted to utilize any resources ... to cooperate with one LLM, ensuring a realistic debugging process.
answer_4.guideline: The annotation process was guided by a detailed set of instructions, outlined in Table E.2. These guidelines provided step-by-step instructions on how to identify, categorize, and label errors.
